explanation: GeneReport takes an optional expressionScope (the survey page's scope for a gene it handed over) and passes it to GeneExpressionCards as surveyScope; onOpenExpression now names the survey page for multi-gene comparison and the catalog rather than the only route to a gene's survey. GeneReport names the studies read under another rename-group member above the differential-expression table (renamedStudies) and tags each such row with its stored symbol; GeneEffectPreview looks the row up under track.storedAs so the preview draws the stored gene.
